# Motion Library

> 224 hand-made web animations and effects. Each one is a single plain JavaScript file with no dependencies: watch it live, read how it works, tune it with sliders, then copy the code or install it with `npx motion-library add <id>`. Every slider is also a CLI flag, so `npx motion-library add confetti --pieces 300` installs it already tuned. Licence: MIT-0.

## Install

- `npx motion-library list` lists every effect.
- `npx motion-library add <id> [--setting value ...]` writes `animations/<id>.js` into the current project (Node 18+).
- Each file's default export takes a sized container element, draws into it and returns a cleanup function.
- `npx motion-library prompt <id>` prints a prompt for an AI coding assistant with the notes, settings and code.
- Source code: https://github.com/AjEckblad/motion-library · npm: https://www.npmjs.com/package/motion-library

## Flow & particles

- [Curl-noise flow field](https://ajeckblad.github.io/motion-library/fx/curl-flow.html): Thousands of particles follow a current that never tangles. `npx motion-library add curl-flow`
- [Drone light show](https://ajeckblad.github.io/motion-library/fx/drone-show.html): Lights fly between shapes without crossing paths. `npx motion-library add drone-show`
- [Particle life](https://ajeckblad.github.io/motion-library/fx/particle-life.html): Specks chase and flee until creatures form; drag to stir. `npx motion-library add particle-life`
- [Cloud chamber](https://ajeckblad.github.io/motion-library/fx/cloud-chamber.html): Invisible radiation leaves misty trails that curl and fade. `npx motion-library add cloud-chamber`
- [Spiral galaxy](https://ajeckblad.github.io/motion-library/fx/galaxy.html): Arms of stars wind slowly round a bright core. `npx motion-library add galaxy`
- [Strange attractor](https://ajeckblad.github.io/motion-library/fx/strange-attractor.html): Glowing trails loop round an apple shape, never repeating. `npx motion-library add strange-attractor`
- [Slime mould maps Tokyo](https://ajeckblad.github.io/motion-library/fx/physarum.html): A web spreads between cities and thins into rail-like routes. `npx motion-library add physarum`
- [Lightning arcs](https://ajeckblad.github.io/motion-library/fx/lightning.html): Forked bolts crackle out from your pointer. `npx motion-library add lightning`
- [Iron filings](https://ajeckblad.github.io/motion-library/fx/iron-filings.html): Steel slivers hop into loops round a hidden magnet; drag it. `npx motion-library add iron-filings`
- [Galton board](https://ajeckblad.github.io/motion-library/fx/galton-board.html): Beads bounce down through pegs and pile up into a bell curve. `npx motion-library add galton-board`
- [Pin art](https://ajeckblad.github.io/motion-library/fx/pin-art.html): A hand and a face rise in steel relief; press to push it back. `npx motion-library add pin-art`
- [3D paper confetti](https://ajeckblad.github.io/motion-library/fx/confetti.html): Two cannons fire coloured bits that tumble and flutter down. `npx motion-library add confetti`

- [Hydrogen orbitals](https://ajeckblad.github.io/motion-library/fx/orbitals.html): A cloud of points flows from one electron shape to the next. `npx motion-library add orbitals`

- [Starling murmuration](https://ajeckblad.github.io/motion-library/fx/murmuration.html): A flock folds and ripples as a falcon dives through. `npx motion-library add murmuration`
- [States of matter](https://ajeckblad.github.io/motion-library/fx/states-of-matter.html): Atoms cool from gas to droplets to crystal, then melt again. `npx motion-library add states-of-matter`
- [Calligraphy brush](https://ajeckblad.github.io/motion-library/fx/calligraphy.html): Writes 永 stroke by stroke, running dry and pooling at turns. `npx motion-library add calligraphy`
- [Harmonograph](https://ajeckblad.github.io/motion-library/fx/harmonograph.html): A swinging pen draws a rosette that spirals in as it slows. `npx motion-library add harmonograph`

- [RGB-split glitch](https://ajeckblad.github.io/motion-library/fx/rgb-glitch.html): A picture breaks into colour copies as slices jump in bursts. `npx motion-library add rgb-glitch`
- [Domain-warped marble](https://ajeckblad.github.io/motion-library/fx/domain-warp.html): Smoky veins of colour fold into each other and keep flowing. `npx motion-library add domain-warp`
- [Truchet flow](https://ajeckblad.github.io/motion-library/fx/truchet.html): Dashes run along winding paths that reroute as tiles turn. `npx motion-library add truchet`
- [Kaleidoscope](https://ajeckblad.github.io/motion-library/fx/kaleidoscope.html): Glass chips tumble in mirrored slices round a turning centre. `npx motion-library add kaleidoscope`
- [Ordered dither](https://ajeckblad.github.io/motion-library/fx/dither.html): A small 3D scene drawn in two inks that read as soft grey. `npx motion-library add dither`
- [Pen sketch](https://ajeckblad.github.io/motion-library/fx/pen-sketch.html): Plaster shapes turn on a stand, drawn in shaky hatched ink. `npx motion-library add pen-sketch`

- [Pixel sort](https://ajeckblad.github.io/motion-library/fx/pixel-sort.html): Bright sky pours down a sunset in streaks, then drains away. `npx motion-library add pixel-sort`
- [Hyperbolic tiling](https://ajeckblad.github.io/motion-library/fx/hyperbolic-tiling.html): Woven stars shrink toward the rim forever, like Escher’s prints. `npx motion-library add hyperbolic-tiling`
- [Stained glass](https://ajeckblad.github.io/motion-library/fx/stained-glass.html): Coloured shafts of sun cross a church; move to shift the light. `npx motion-library add stained-glass`

## Simulation

- [Brian’s Brain](https://ajeckblad.github.io/motion-library/fx/brians-brain.html): Tiny ships streak, crash and spawn new ones; drag to draw. `npx motion-library add brians-brain`

- [Doom fire](https://ajeckblad.github.io/motion-library/fx/doom-fire.html): Chunky pixel flames sway and roar back; drag to add heat. `npx motion-library add doom-fire`
- [Water ripples](https://ajeckblad.github.io/motion-library/fx/water-ripple.html): Drops ring across a sunny pond; drag for a wake, tap to splash. `npx motion-library add water-ripple`
- [Double pendulums](https://ajeckblad.github.io/motion-library/fx/double-pendulum.html): Nine swing as one, then split apart; move to hold the pivot. `npx motion-library add double-pendulum`
- [N-body orbits](https://ajeckblad.github.io/motion-library/fx/orbits.html): Planets loop twin suns in rosettes; tap to drop a new one. `npx motion-library add orbits`
- [Vortex drain](https://ajeckblad.github.io/motion-library/fx/vortex.html): Streaks spiral into a hole that follows your pointer. `npx motion-library add vortex`
- [Plexus](https://ajeckblad.github.io/motion-library/fx/plexus.html): Drifting dots link up with fine lines; move to gather them. `npx motion-library add plexus`
- [Lenia](https://ajeckblad.github.io/motion-library/fx/lenia.html): Soft lifelike blobs glide, spin and heal; drag to wound one. `npx motion-library add lenia`
- [Differential growth](https://ajeckblad.github.io/motion-library/fx/diff-growth.html): An ink line outgrows the page and folds into a maze. `npx motion-library add diff-growth`
- [Snowflake growth](https://ajeckblad.github.io/motion-library/fx/snowflake.html): Ice grows six branching arms, then a fresh crystal starts. `npx motion-library add snowflake`
- [Mud cracks](https://ajeckblad.github.io/motion-library/fx/mud-cracks.html): Wet clay dries into curled plates; drag to wet a patch again. `npx motion-library add mud-cracks`

- [Seven-segment clock](https://ajeckblad.github.io/motion-library/fx/seven-segment.html): A live LED readout ticks hundredths, unlit bars faint behind. `npx motion-library add seven-segment`
- [LED dot-matrix sign](https://ajeckblad.github.io/motion-library/fx/led-matrix.html): Amber text scrolls across a board of round glowing bulbs. `npx motion-library add led-matrix`
- [Radar sweep](https://ajeckblad.github.io/motion-library/fx/radar-sweep.html): A turning beam lights up blips that fade until the next pass. `npx motion-library add radar-sweep`
- [Heart monitor](https://ajeckblad.github.io/motion-library/fx/ekg.html): A green heartbeat trace writes across, wiping as it goes. `npx motion-library add ekg`
- [Spectrum analyser](https://ajeckblad.github.io/motion-library/fx/audio-bars.html): Bars jump to a beat while their peak caps hang, then drop. `npx motion-library add audio-bars`
- [Neon tubes](https://ajeckblad.github.io/motion-library/fx/neon-pipes.html): Bright coloured glass snakes across a dark wall. `npx motion-library add neon-pipes`
- [Targeting HUD](https://ajeckblad.github.io/motion-library/fx/crosshair-hud.html): A sight follows your pointer and locks onto nearby blips. `npx motion-library add crosshair-hud`

## Basics

- [Fade & scale in](https://ajeckblad.github.io/motion-library/fx/fade-scale.html): Old shop cards leave fast and new ones rise in, one by one. `npx motion-library add fade-scale`
- [Stagger grid](https://ajeckblad.github.io/motion-library/fx/stagger-grid.html): A colour change ripples out from the tapped swatch. `npx motion-library add stagger-grid`
- [Easing curves race](https://ajeckblad.github.io/motion-library/fx/easing-race.html): Four toggles side by side show why ease-out feels fastest. `npx motion-library add easing-race`
- [3D card flip](https://ajeckblad.github.io/motion-library/fx/card-flip.html): Turns over to show the back when the CVC field is in focus. `npx motion-library add card-flip`
- [Anticipation & follow-through](https://ajeckblad.github.io/motion-library/fx/anticipation.html): A product crouches, hops into the bag and the handle swings. `npx motion-library add anticipation`
- [List reorder (FLIP)](https://ajeckblad.github.io/motion-library/fx/list-reorder.html): Leaderboard rows glide to new ranks, climbers passing above. `npx motion-library add list-reorder`
- [Add & remove](https://ajeckblad.github.io/motion-library/fx/add-remove.html): An item fades, the rest close the gap, and Undo reverses it. `npx motion-library add add-remove`
- [Number ticker](https://ajeckblad.github.io/motion-library/fx/number-ticker.html): Each digit rolls to its new value when a stat changes. `npx motion-library add number-ticker`
- [Accordion FAQ](https://ajeckblad.github.io/motion-library/fx/accordion-faq.html): Answers open one at a time, the text a beat behind. `npx motion-library add accordion-faq`
- [Tab swap](https://ajeckblad.github.io/motion-library/fx/tab-swap.html): A dark pill stretches to the picked item, front edge first. `npx motion-library add tab-swap`

## Page transitions

- [Push slide](https://ajeckblad.github.io/motion-library/fx/push-slide.html): A new screen sweeps in as the old one drifts back and dims. `npx motion-library add push-slide`
- [Circle reveal](https://ajeckblad.github.io/motion-library/fx/circle-reveal.html): Tap anywhere and the new theme floods out from that point. `npx motion-library add circle-reveal`
- [Staircase wipe](https://ajeckblad.github.io/motion-library/fx/staircase-wipe.html): Coloured bars sweep down over the page and carry on out. `npx motion-library add staircase-wipe`
- [Shared-element expand](https://ajeckblad.github.io/motion-library/fx/shared-expand.html): A product photo grows from its card into the page header. `npx motion-library add shared-expand`
- [View Transitions morph](https://ajeckblad.github.io/motion-library/fx/view-transition.html): An album cover grows into the open album’s header, and back. `npx motion-library add view-transition`
- [iOS sheet](https://ajeckblad.github.io/motion-library/fx/ios-sheet.html): A panel slides up while the page behind steps back and dims. `npx motion-library add ios-sheet`
- [Lightbox zoom](https://ajeckblad.github.io/motion-library/fx/lightbox-zoom.html): A thumbnail grows into a full-screen photo and shrinks back. `npx motion-library add lightbox-zoom`
- [Directional tabs](https://ajeckblad.github.io/motion-library/fx/directional-tabs.html): Products slide in from the side of the category you picked. `npx motion-library add directional-tabs`
- [Blur crossfade](https://ajeckblad.github.io/motion-library/fx/blur-crossfade.html): Grid view melts into list view without a messy double image. `npx motion-library add blur-crossfade`
- [Card stack swipe](https://ajeckblad.github.io/motion-library/fx/card-stack-swipe.html): Photos tilt, get stamped Keep or Delete and fly off the pile. `npx motion-library add card-stack-swipe`
- [Page turn](https://ajeckblad.github.io/motion-library/fx/page-turn.html): A book flips its own leaves; drag the right one to try it. `npx motion-library add page-turn`

## Text

- [Letter rise stagger](https://ajeckblad.github.io/motion-library/fx/letter-rise.html): A name springs up from a hidden edge, one character at a time. `npx motion-library add letter-rise`
- [Scramble decode](https://ajeckblad.github.io/motion-library/fx/scramble.html): Random characters churn, then lock into words left to right. `npx motion-library add scramble`
- [Variable-font wave](https://ajeckblad.github.io/motion-library/fx/vf-wave.html): A bulge of weight and width rolls along a word. `npx motion-library add vf-wave`
- [Typewriter](https://ajeckblad.github.io/motion-library/fx/typewriter.html): A search box types example trips with human pauses. `npx motion-library add typewriter`
- [Line mask reveal](https://ajeckblad.github.io/motion-library/fx/line-mask.html): Headline rows slide up one by one from a hidden edge. `npx motion-library add line-mask`
- [Split-flap board](https://ajeckblad.github.io/motion-library/fx/split-flap.html): Letters flip like an airport departures sign. `npx motion-library add split-flap`
- [Odometer counter](https://ajeckblad.github.io/motion-library/fx/odometer.html): A charity total rolls up with each new gift, wheel by wheel. `npx motion-library add odometer`
- [Rotating word](https://ajeckblad.github.io/motion-library/fx/rotating-word.html): The end of a headline keeps changing, sliding through a slot. `npx motion-library add rotating-word`
- [Marker highlight](https://ajeckblad.github.io/motion-library/fx/highlighter.html): A wobbly pen stroke sweeps behind key phrases, line by line. `npx motion-library add highlighter`
- [Text on a circle](https://ajeckblad.github.io/motion-library/fx/text-circle.html): A ring of words turns slowly; move over it to spin it up. `npx motion-library add text-circle`
- [Type ribbon](https://ajeckblad.github.io/motion-library/fx/type-ribbon.html): Words run round a twisting Möbius band; move to tilt the view. `npx motion-library add type-ribbon`

## Scroll

- [Parallax layers](https://ajeckblad.github.io/motion-library/fx/parallax.html): Far mountains lag as the page scrolls, near ones keep pace. `npx motion-library add parallax`
- [Scrub reveal](https://ajeckblad.github.io/motion-library/fx/scrub-reveal.html): A statement lights up word by word as you scroll. `npx motion-library add scrub-reveal`
- [Pinned horizontal track](https://ajeckblad.github.io/motion-library/fx/pinned-track.html): Scrolling down slides a row of projects sideways. `npx motion-library add pinned-track`
- [Zoom-through](https://ajeckblad.github.io/motion-library/fx/zoom-through.html): Scrolling flies you inside the O of a giant word. `npx motion-library add zoom-through`
- [Velocity-skew marquee](https://ajeckblad.github.io/motion-library/fx/velocity-skew.html): Scrolling text races and leans the faster you flick. `npx motion-library add velocity-skew`
- [Reading progress](https://ajeckblad.github.io/motion-library/fx/reading-progress.html): A thin bar fills as you read and the minutes left count down. `npx motion-library add reading-progress`
- [Sticky card stack](https://ajeckblad.github.io/motion-library/fx/sticky-stack.html): Steps pile up as you scroll, older ones shrinking back. `npx motion-library add sticky-stack`
- [Timeline draw](https://ajeckblad.github.io/motion-library/fx/timeline-draw.html): A line grows down the page as you scroll, years popping in. `npx motion-library add timeline-draw`
- [Image-sequence scrub](https://ajeckblad.github.io/motion-library/fx/sequence-scrub.html): A shoe turns a full circle as you scroll, frame by frame. `npx motion-library add sequence-scrub`
- [Snap gallery](https://ajeckblad.github.io/motion-library/fx/snap-gallery.html): Photos click into place one by one, the centre one growing. `npx motion-library add snap-gallery`

## Hover & cursor

- [Magnetic button](https://ajeckblad.github.io/motion-library/fx/magnetic.html): Leans toward the pointer as it nears, the label leaning further. `npx motion-library add magnetic`
- [Click ripple](https://ajeckblad.github.io/motion-library/fx/ripple.html): Press a button and a soft circle spreads from the exact spot. `npx motion-library add ripple`
- [3D tilt card](https://ajeckblad.github.io/motion-library/fx/tilt.html): Turns toward the cursor and lifts, catching a sliding glare. `npx motion-library add tilt`
- [Cursor trail](https://ajeckblad.github.io/motion-library/fx/cursor-trail.html): A warm ribbon follows the pointer and curls with every move. `npx motion-library add cursor-trail`
- [Spotlight reveal](https://ajeckblad.github.io/motion-library/fx/spotlight.html): A soft torch follows the cursor through a dark veil. `npx motion-library add spotlight`
- [Image follow](https://ajeckblad.github.io/motion-library/fx/image-follow.html): Move down a project list and each preview trails the cursor. `npx motion-library add image-follow`
- [Directional fill](https://ajeckblad.github.io/motion-library/fx/directional-fill.html): Colour floods in from the side you enter, out the side you leave. `npx motion-library add directional-fill`
- [Sliding underline](https://ajeckblad.github.io/motion-library/fx/underline-slide.html): One nav marker stretches to whichever link you point at. `npx motion-library add underline-slide`
- [Lit border](https://ajeckblad.github.io/motion-library/fx/lit-border.html): Card edges in a dark grid light up around the cursor. `npx motion-library add lit-border`
- [Dock magnify](https://ajeckblad.github.io/motion-library/fx/dock-magnify.html): Icons swell under the cursor and push their neighbours apart. `npx motion-library add dock-magnify`

## Micro & loading

- [Toggle spring](https://ajeckblad.github.io/motion-library/fx/toggle.html): Tap a switch and its knob stretches as it slides, then lands. `npx motion-library add toggle`
- [Like burst](https://ajeckblad.github.io/motion-library/fx/like-burst.html): Tap the heart and it squashes, pops and fires a ring of dots. `npx motion-library add like-burst`
- [Submit to success](https://ajeckblad.github.io/motion-library/fx/submit-success.html): Tap Send; the button becomes a spinner, then a green tick. `npx motion-library add submit-success`
- [Arc spinner](https://ajeckblad.github.io/motion-library/fx/arc-spinner.html): A loading ring whose stroke grows and shrinks as it turns. `npx motion-library add arc-spinner`
- [Skeleton shimmer](https://ajeckblad.github.io/motion-library/fx/skeleton.html): Grey placeholders hold the layout until real items fade in. `npx motion-library add skeleton`
- [Copy to tick](https://ajeckblad.github.io/motion-library/fx/copy-tick.html): Tap Copy and the icon becomes a check with a Copied label. `npx motion-library add copy-tick`
- [Password strength](https://ajeckblad.github.io/motion-library/fx/password-strength.html): A meter fills and rules tick off as the text is typed. `npx motion-library add password-strength`
- [Hold to delete](https://ajeckblad.github.io/motion-library/fx/hold-delete.html): Press and hold to fill the button red; let go early to undo. `npx motion-library add hold-delete`
- [Bell and badge](https://ajeckblad.github.io/motion-library/fx/bell-badge.html): Each new alert rings it, and the count pops up or rolls on. `npx motion-library add bell-badge`
- [Toast stack](https://ajeckblad.github.io/motion-library/fx/toast-stack.html): New messages rise in front as older ones step back and fade. `npx motion-library add toast-stack`

## Springs & physics

- [Squash & stretch bounce](https://ajeckblad.github.io/motion-library/fx/squash-bounce.html): Tap Add to bag and a mug flies in, squashing as it lands. `npx motion-library add squash-bounce`
- [Rubber-band drag](https://ajeckblad.github.io/motion-library/fx/rubber-band.html): Drag past the last photo and it resists, then springs back. `npx motion-library add rubber-band`
- [Pendulum wave](https://ajeckblad.github.io/motion-library/fx/pendulum-wave.html): Glowing weights drift out of step, snake about, then line up. `npx motion-library add pendulum-wave`
- [Verlet rope](https://ajeckblad.github.io/motion-library/fx/verlet-rope.html): Tug the lamp’s pull cord to switch it, or flick it to swing. `npx motion-library add verlet-rope`
- [Ball collisions](https://ajeckblad.github.io/motion-library/fx/ball-collisions.html): Tap a bubble to grow it and watch it shove the rest aside. `npx motion-library add ball-collisions`
- [Snap-point bottom sheet](https://ajeckblad.github.io/motion-library/fx/bottom-sheet.html): Fling the map panel and it springs to the nearest stop. `npx motion-library add bottom-sheet`
- [Swipe to dismiss](https://ajeckblad.github.io/motion-library/fx/swipe-dismiss.html): Flick a notification away and the rest close the gap. `npx motion-library add swipe-dismiss`
- [Chat heads](https://ajeckblad.github.io/motion-library/fx/chat-heads.html): Drag the bubbles; they trail in a chain and dock at an edge. `npx motion-library add chat-heads`
- [Jelly app icon](https://ajeckblad.github.io/motion-library/fx/icon-jelly.html): Drag it to a new slot; it stretches, then wobbles as it lands. `npx motion-library add icon-jelly`
- [Pull to refresh](https://ajeckblad.github.io/motion-library/fx/pull-refresh.html): Drag the inbox down; it resists, waits, then springs back. `npx motion-library add pull-refresh`

- [Shape morph](https://ajeckblad.github.io/motion-library/fx/shape-morph.html): Album covers melt into the next track’s outline and colour. `npx motion-library add shape-morph`
- [Icon morph](https://ajeckblad.github.io/motion-library/fx/icon-morph.html): Tap and a download arrow folds into a check, a list into a grid. `npx motion-library add icon-morph`
- [Gooey blobs](https://ajeckblad.github.io/motion-library/fx/gooey.html): Tap the add button and its actions ooze out like liquid. `npx motion-library add gooey`
- [Line draw-on](https://ajeckblad.github.io/motion-library/fx/line-draw.html): Chart strokes trace the week, one just after the other. `npx motion-library add line-draw`
- [Liquid button](https://ajeckblad.github.io/motion-library/fx/liquid-button.html): Move over it and its edge ripples; press to squeeze it. `npx motion-library add liquid-button`
- [Play to pause](https://ajeckblad.github.io/motion-library/fx/play-pause.html): Tap and the triangle splits and slides into two bars. `npx motion-library add play-pause`
- [Menu to close](https://ajeckblad.github.io/motion-library/fx/menu-close.html): Tap and three lines fold into an X as the panel wipes open. `npx motion-library add menu-close`
- [Chart morph](https://ajeckblad.github.io/motion-library/fx/chart-morph.html): Tap a range and the line flows into the new data. `npx motion-library add chart-morph`
- [Logo draw](https://ajeckblad.github.io/motion-library/fx/logo-draw.html): A brand mark traces itself like a pen, then fills in. `npx motion-library add logo-draw`
- [Button to menu](https://ajeckblad.github.io/motion-library/fx/button-menu.html): Tap Share and it opens out into a list of options. `npx motion-library add button-menu`
- [Dynamic island](https://ajeckblad.github.io/motion-library/fx/dynamic-island.html): The camera pill grows into calls and music; tap to open the player. `npx motion-library add dynamic-island`
